findings.identity_explanation: Tag LIFT-02 matches exactly in CR:LIFT-02, ES:LIFT-02, FM:TFM-0302, COM-08, WAR-08 and OM-07. Model VX-1600 and serial VX16-7102 agree wherever stated. Location conflicts: CR, ES and COM-08 say Core B, but FM:TFM-0302 says Core A.

exceptions.finding: The FM register places LIFT-02 in Core A. The construction register, equipment schedule and commissioning certificate place it in Core B. Core A is where LIFT-01 is located per COM-08, so this may be an FM register entry error, but no source settles it and it must not be assumed. Because LIFT-02 is a life-safety asset, this open exception makes it critical under Readiness 3.1.

evidence.quote: Asset: LIFT-02 | Model: VX-1600 | Serial: VX16-7102 | Location: Core B

exceptions.responsible_party: Main contractor (Halvorn Contracting) to confirm location on site; FM CAFM administrator to correct the FM register only if it is wrong
exceptions.next_action: Ask the contractor to confirm on site where LIFT-02 is installed. The FM team corrects its own register if it is wrong (Readiness 5.5). Keep all records unchanged until then.

findings.summary: LIFT-02 has commissioning (Pass, Signed), a warranty valid to 2028-10-05 with a matching serial, an O&M manual and a PPM plan, all read directly. However the FM register shows its location as Core A while the other sources show Core B. As a life-safety lift with an open exception it is not ready for acceptance and is escalated.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager, consulting the FM operations manager (life-safety asset)
findings.escalation_reason: Life-safety asset (lift) has an open location conflict (Escalation 2.1), and no source settles whether Core A or Core B is correct (Escalation 2.3). They must decide whether to send the on-site verification request and how to resolve the FM register entry.
findings.clarification_subject: LIFT-02 passenger lift: please confirm installed location (Core A or Core B)
findings.clarification_body: Hello, for the Sarava Tower handover (planned 24 November 2026), the records for LIFT-02 (Vertica Lifts VX-1600, serial VX16-7102) disagree on location. The construction register, equipment schedule and commissioning certificate COM-08 show Core B, while our FM register shows Core A. Please verify on site where LIFT-02 is installed and confirm in writing, including the serial plate reading. We will correct our own register if it is wrong. Thank you.
uncertainties: Which location, Core A or Core B, is correct is not settled by any source.
Whether the FM register entry was mixed up with LIFT-01 (Core A) is unknown.
